items.quote: Mom is calling siblings, extended family and friends a huge amount of times a day asking for assistance in moving her back to her home from care center.
items.label: Mom calls family constantly to go home

items.quote: this sister will not acknowledge or take action on our request to remove cell phone.
items.label: Sister with phone plan will not act

items.quote: Mom's anxiety and paranoia is going thru the roof because we are not answering all of the calls.
items.label: Mom's anxiety rises when calls unanswered

items.quote: she would call 10x-plus in a row while at work and I needed my phone to be on
items.label: Repeated calls while at work

items.quote: I what to protect her from his bad decisions, but sometimes I can’t.
items.label: Protect parent from sibling's decisions

items.quote: Personally, if we keep staff informed via email of Mom's upcoming appointments that should work.
items.label: Keep mom informed of appointments without phone

items.quote: My Mom had agreed to move into AL and then turned around yesterday (about a week before it was time to move) and says 100% no way.
items.label: Mom refuses move days before

items.quote: She isn't safe at home.
items.label: Wants mom safe

items.quote: I'm supposed to be enjoying my one and only child's high school years
items.label: Enjoy child's high school years

items.quote: my sister says if she wants to stay, she should stay.
items.label: Sister disagrees with moving mom

items.quote: Most days if I'm not there, she's eating cookies and chips and nothing else.
items.label: Mom eats poorly when alone

items.quote: Just to have someone take care of ME for a change.
items.label: Wants to be cared for herself

items.quote: I am very resentful of the 4 hours a week that I run her around or when other appointments come up.
items.label: Resents weekly driving time

items.quote: I feel trapped and don’t want to even do that afternoon a week.
items.label: Feels trapped even with boundary

items.quote: we know we can’t leave for extended periods of time like we would like too.
items.label: Wants to travel longer

items.quote: I feel selfish and guilty all the time.
items.label: Constant guilt and selfishness feelings

items.quote: I started working part time just to escape my own brain being consumed by her.
items.label: Mind consumed by caring for mom

items.quote: I know we need to find out what health/medicaid plans he has so we know what services will be covered.
items.label: Learn which services insurance covers

items.quote: needs help with bills, rotting food in fridge, more forgetfulness
items.label: Early decline signs at home

items.quote: I guess I am asking for advice on what else we could be doing now
items.label: Know what to do now

items.quote: the weekend totally consumed when we all thought he had lost his wallet still full of cards and IDs
items.label: Lost wallet consumed a weekend

items.quote: I also observed a lot of dropped meds on the floor and poor hygiene
items.label: Dropped meds and poor hygiene

items.quote: Paul refuses to send me any of his past mail (which would include any outstanding bills), or any of his spending receipts
items.label: Brother stopped sending mail and receipts

items.quote: Paul also refuses to maintain any or sort of budget in regard to spending
items.label: Brother keeps no spending budget

items.quote: I don't want to vindictively move our dad into an adult living center and kick him to the curb
items.label: Avoid moving dad out of spite

items.quote: I can't go on under this arrangement
items.label: Cannot continue current arrangement

items.quote: I do the same for my mother with no assistance at all from my two brothers.
items.label: Caring for mother without sibling help

items.quote: I feel like I've lost my home, my refuge.
items.label: Lost home as refuge

items.quote: My Dad can't afford to live independently, so I feel like I've got no choice.
items.label: Dad cannot afford own place

items.quote: It's now more stressful if I want to go on vacation with my husband.
items.label: Vacations harder with mom at home

items.quote: I still worry she will leave something on and cause a fire or something if she gets more forgetful.
items.label: Worry about fire if more forgetful

items.quote: I am delaying retirement because I don't want to be home full time caring for someone
items.label: Delaying retirement to avoid full-time care

items.quote: so the difference is coming out of their savings.
items.label: Care costs drain parents' savings

items.quote: Coincidentally both will run out of savings in about 2 years.
items.label: Both parents' savings end in 2 years

items.quote: I plan to move him when he has 1 year left of funds unless he is really near the end.
items.label: Move dad to Medicaid place before funds end

items.quote: I didn’t find this out until she had been there a while and she didn’t have enough to cover the necessary 2 years somewhere else.
items.label: Learned late facility Medicaid terms

items.quote: This representative was quoting me much lower rates (3-4 k for assisted living and 9-10 k per month for memory care) which seems suspicious.
items.label: Facility price quotes seem inconsistent

items.quote: Her AL charges her $205 for COPD management.
items.label: Assisted living charges for unneeded service

items.quote: I asked WHAT exactly are you managing?? No answer.
items.label: Facility cannot explain a charge

items.quote: Her payments are auto deducted so they can take what they want.
items.label: Auto-deducted payments to facility

items.quote: the billing was screwed up every single month.
items.label: Facility billing wrong every month

items.quote: I was wanting to take Mom so that we could spend time together outside of the facility and most importantly so Mom could pick her own yarn.
items.label: Take mom out to choose her yarn

items.quote: Am I wrong for still wanting to allow Mom to make her own decisions?
items.label: Let mom keep making her own choices

items.quote: My sister who is Guardian of the Person does not share that information with me.
items.label: Guardian sister withholds mom's condition

items.quote: Communication between my sister and I is only through an attorney.
items.label: Sibling communication only via attorney

items.quote: I was informed by the facility that approval was needed by the sister and the sister only approved going to lunch near by and and only for a couple of hours
items.label: Needs sister's approval for outings

items.quote: The problem is she would want to buy 10 things of yarn for a huge project she would never be able to finish.
items.label: Mom over-buys supplies for unfinished projects

items.quote: It's been a month now and we still havent applied for Medicaid.
items.label: Medicaid not yet applied for

items.quote: the attorney wanted to speak to my SIL because she was also a POA. Unfortunately she was hospitalized for mania.
items.label: Co-POA hospitalized, blocks attorney

items.quote: I don't even know if I want to be a caregiver or have the ability to be.
items.label: Unsure of wanting or able to caregive

items.quote: my spouse and I were not planning on having any dependents in the foreseeable future.
items.label: Had not planned on caring for anyone

items.quote: Just feels like I'm grasping at some kind of control.
items.label: Feels lack of control

items.quote: she has been suffering severely in the evenings with sundowning and hallucinations.
items.label: Evening sundowning and hallucinations

items.quote: We have tried several techniques to navigate these episodes, but recently, nothing seems to work
items.label: Calming techniques stopped working

items.quote: her symptoms are progressing far quicker than our ability to learn how to care for her.
items.label: Symptoms outpace family's learning

items.quote: There are times when she will not be distracted.
items.label: Mom cannot be distracted at times

items.quote: Trying to keep her home.
items.label: Keep mom at home

items.quote: By 7 am she’s soaked and so is her bed.
items.label: Mom and bed soaked by morning

items.quote: I can’t wake up in middle of night and change her.
items.label: Cannot wake to change her at night

items.quote: I promised my parents I would never put them in a nursing home and I plan to keep that promise.
items.label: Keep promise not to use nursing home

items.quote: It was a lot of work every morning of cleaning him up, and doing all the laundry.
items.label: Morning cleanup and laundry workload

items.quote: Hard to take care of someone with only a few hours of sleep every night.
items.label: Caring on too little sleep

items.quote: I have not worked for the last year because her anxiety about being at home with a caregiver was making it impossible for me to focus on a job
items.label: Stopped working due to mom's anxiety

items.quote: I still feel guilty about placing her in a nursing home.
items.label: Guilt after nursing home placement

items.quote: quite frankly, medically not really safe for her to be at home
items.label: Mom not safe at home

items.quote: Sometimes she says I "tricked" her into being there.
items.label: Mom says she was tricked

items.quote: There are no siblings, no wife, no ex-wife and no children to assist me.
items.label: No family to help with care

items.quote: She has walked, "jogged", alone, up and down the street we live on every day and only recently, and on only one occasion (that we know of) gotten disoriented and lost.
items.label: Mom walks alone and got lost

items.quote: I initially spiraled, as I do whenever something seems to signal a new threat level and need for greater care.
items.label: Spirals at signs of greater care need

items.quote: Can she no longer be left alone? Do I hire a caregiver? For how many hours per day?
items.label: Decide how much supervision is needed

items.quote: use a GPS tracker in the form of a watch that has a lock and can be set for a "green zone".
items.label: Track mom's location with GPS watch

items.quote: I need help and support to help my mother better.
items.label: Help mom cope as caregiver

items.quote: I feel frustration because I have been giving her solutions to this.
items.label: Frustrated mom keeps venting without acting

items.quote: we didn't want our mother to get hurt or hurt anyone else.
items.label: Keep mom and others from harm

items.quote: I tried buying her some warmer clothes and bringing them to her but I saw that she was frustrated because some fit, others did not
items.label: Bought clothes did not fit

items.quote: Do I take her out shopping for warmer clothes if I can get approval from the sister who is Guardian of the Person?
items.label: Needs guardian sister's approval to shop

items.quote: I am the only one who brought my Mom items to make her more comfortable in her room.
items.label: Wants mom comfortable in her room

items.quote: I felt like I was not allowing her to make the decision herself on the clothes.
items.label: Let mom decide for herself

items.quote: I (27F) have recently made the decision that my dear mama (62 w/Alzheimer’s) requires full on assisted living.
items.label: Place mom in assisted living

items.quote: have come to the cross roads of continuing to care for mama, or continue my own life
items.label: Continue own life versus caregiving

items.quote: I’m currently in school, and as hard as I try I can’t focus in school the way I need to.
items.label: Cannot focus in school

items.quote: I am flooded with guilt and horrible thoughts of how heartbroken she is going to be.
items.label: Guilt about placing mom

items.quote: I am now showering her, wiping her after bathroom visits, etc.
items.label: Doing intimate personal care alone

items.quote: But the idea of leaving my mom somewhere and her begging me to not leave her, I get sick whenever I think about it.
items.label: Dreads mom begging not to be left

items.quote: All I want is for my mom to feel comfortable and as little anxiety as possible.
items.label: Mom comfortable with little anxiety

items.quote: I usually have to repeatedly ask her to try to open them.
items.label: Mom keeps eyes closed when talking

items.quote: After about 1pm is when it’s the worst and she is very out of it.
items.label: Worst after 1pm with sundowning

items.quote: She wanders the house trying to find him and is constantly asking where he is.
items.label: Mom keeps searching for late father

items.quote: At first we were telling her that he died but that would cause a meltdown every time and it was heartbreaking.
items.label: Telling mom of death causes meltdowns

items.quote: We have tried fibbing and then diverting her attention but that’s not working.
items.label: Fibbing and diverting no longer work

items.quote: I feel like I can’t even call her (I don’t live nearby) because I will just be a reminder of my dad.
items.label: Cannot call mom from far away

items.quote: I can’t take this and really don’t know what to do.
items.label: Overwhelmed and unsure what to do

items.quote: His short term memory is gone. The repetitive questions are nearly non stop.
items.label: Dad's memory gone, nonstop repeated questions

items.quote: I've got no family support or anyone to lean on except his other caregivers
items.label: No family support to lean on

items.quote: It's just getting tougher and tougher for me to be with him.
items.label: Visits getting harder

items.quote: I'm really truly broken at this point and the thing is, I know it's only going to get worse.
items.label: Broken and expects decline to worsen

items.quote: This has really affected me not in a good way.
items.label: Dad's diagnosis hit hard

items.quote: The responsibility is overwhelming!
items.label: Responsibility feels overwhelming

items.quote: My mom wandered from her usual walking route and was brought home by police after a neighbor recognized a disoriented senior on a bench in our neighborhood.
items.label: Mom wandered, brought home by police

items.quote: still feel she is better with us.
items.label: Believes mom better at home

items.quote: I've been noticing mom overeating.
items.label: Mom overeating

items.quote: she would eat all of the snacks in one day if I left them with her
items.label: Mom eats all snacks in a day

items.quote: I recently had to put a baby door handle cover to go down to our laundry room because she was doing laundry multiple times a day
items.label: Mom does laundry repeatedly

items.quote: looking for how to transition to helping mom in the shower, this is something I have not overcome.
items.label: Start helping mom shower

items.quote: most days, she is quiet. She rarely speaks during visits.
items.label: Mom quiet and rarely speaks on visits

items.quote: Treats are meh now, even chocolate, which breaks my heart.
items.label: Mom no longer enjoys treats

items.quote: I want to match her tone, but it’s hard.
items.label: Match mom's tone during visits

items.quote: Then at about 10pm last night, he had a psychotic episode - was verbally abusive and physically violent.
items.label: Violent episode at night after move

items.quote: I am fearful this will happen again tonight.
items.label: Fear of episode recurring tonight

items.quote: she often orders vitamins and other brain supplements—getting scammed—but doesn’t remember doing it due to her severe short-term memory issues.
items.label: Mom scammed buying supplements

items.quote: Does anyone have any advice on how to limit this vulnerability/stopping so much spam or limiting charges?
items.label: Limit scam charges on mom's orders
